title: External agents (A2A)
subtitle: Credentials for a partner's software (ERP, orchestrator) to call this tenant's pools through the A2A channel. The credential is shown once; only its hash is stored. Each pool must be a contact pool with the A2A channel and a contract that admits partners.
readOnly: Read-only: creating, rotating and deactivating needs config.agents read_write.
poolsHint: Only contact pools with the A2A channel and a contract that admits partners — and, unless you grant permissions, only pools in your own scope.
noGrantablePools: No pool you can grant exposes A2A to partners. Mark the A2A channel and contract on a contact pool first.
rotateConfirm: Rotate the credential of {{name}}? The current one stops working at once (the gateway may still accept it for up to 30 s).
secretHint: Copy it now and hand it to the partner as Authorization: Bearer. It will not be shown again — only rotating issues a new one.
